role: Awwwards-level web designer and front-end craftsperson
verdict: Composition, rhythm and motion hold at 1440, 390 and 360: every heading is two lines, CLS is effectively zero (0.00002), no horizontal scroll, 9.99 phone screens at 390 and 9.70 at 360, no console errors, a clean reduced-motion static layout with no infinite animations, visible focus rings and no undersized tap targets. What is left is small P2 polish that no visitor meets in the first five seconds of any section.

issues.problem: The on-device engine bundle is 571 KB raw (about 188 KB gzipped), larger than the whole page (318 KB raw / 83 KB gz) plus its font. It is fetched async so it does not block paint, but it is the single heaviest request on a marketing page and costs parse time on mid-range phones.
issues.fix: Keep it lazy, but only fetch on first intent (focus or pointerenter on the Try box, a chip, the final input, or when #sharpen comes within one viewport), not on idle; and build a homepage-only bundle that tree-shakes anything sharpenLine does not reach. Target under 90 KB gzipped.

issues.where: #sharpen result status line after sharpening a line that yields three notes (e.g. 'Cut 2 bits of fluff · Split it into two beats · 1 left to you')
issues.problem: The line wraps mid-list and leaves a dangling middle dot at the end of the first row ('Cut 2 bits of fluff ·' / 'Split it into two beats · 1 left to you').
issues.fix: Wrap each note in an inline-block span that owns its leading separator (separator as ::before on every span but the first, white-space:nowrap per span), so a break never strands a dot.

issues.where: .mbar at 390/360, e.g. over the Voice tile 'Put it back' row and the Results tile
issues.problem: The fixed 62px Start free bar sits on top of live demo controls as they scroll through the bottom of the viewport, so a control can be half covered at the moment the visitor reaches for it.
issues.fix: Keep the bar, but give it a taller top fade (24px gradient from transparent to the ground colour) and add scroll-padding-bottom:72px plus scroll-margin-bottom on focusable demo controls so keyboard and tap-to-focus never land under it.

issues.problem: The supporting sentence ('Paste 8 posts...') floats top-right with a left edge (about x=916) that aligns to nothing else in the tile or the grid, while every other tile keeps its support copy under the heading.
issues.fix: Align the paragraph's left edge to the start of the third rewrite card column (x of 'The story' card) or right-align it to the tile's inner edge with max-width 34ch, so it locks to an existing line.

issues.where: #sharpen with a 200+ character draft at 1440 and 390
issues.problem: A long draft produces a six-line result card and the adjacent preview tile grows with it, so the Try tile and Previews tile jump about 90px taller and push the Voice tile down after the visitor's own action (not counted as CLS, but felt).
issues.fix: Cap the result card and the Yours preview post at 4 lines with a soft fade and a 'Show all' toggle, or reserve the taller min-height on the row so the grid below does not move.
